steps.name: decrypt_with_rotation GREEN
criteria: decrypt_with_rotation tries current_key first and succeeds without previous
Falls back to previous_key on current-key AEAD failure and succeeds
Returns AuthenticationFailed when neither key decrypts
Returns Malformed when ciphertext is under 12 bytes
Correct for TOTP, client-secret, and DSN shaped ciphertext
steps.implementation_notes: Replace the RED panic! body per ADR-018 section 5. Try Aes256Gcm decrypt with current_key; on AEAD failure retry previous_key if Some; ciphertext under 12 bytes returns Malformed before any decrypt attempt. Remove #[ignore] from both in-memory tests in sm03. Pure function, no IO.

steps.name: Async config plus AWS admin key walking skeleton
criteria: ServerConfig::from_env is async and all existing callers await it
AwsSecretFetcher::get_raw_secret returns the raw secret string
EMBYR_ADMIN_KEY_AWS_SECRET_ARN sources the admin key at startup
Walking skeleton scenario passes with zero literal admin key in env
main.rs Step 1 awaits from_env before tracing init
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-018 section 1-3. Refactor AwsSecretFetcher::fetch_raw to share the network-call portion between get_dsn's parse_dsn path and a new get_raw_secret(arn) -> Result<String, AwsSecretError> that returns the secret string verbatim. ServerConfig::from_env() becomes `pub async fn from_env() -> Result<Self, ConfigError>`; construct AwsSecretFetcher lazily inside from_env only when EMBYR_ADMIN_KEY_AWS_SECRET_ARN is set, via aws_config::load_from_env().await (standard SDK default chain, honours AWS_ENDPOINT_URL for LocalStack). Update main.rs call site to `.await`. Find and update every existing test/call site that calls ServerConfig::from_env() synchronously (grep the whole workspace) to #[tokio::test] + .await -- this is the ADR-018-flagged blast-radius risk, verify with `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace --no-run` before declaring GREEN. Do not yet implement ambiguity/fetch-failure/GCP paths -- those are later steps; only the happy-path AWS ARN resolution is required to turn the walking skeleton GREEN.

steps.name: Wire decrypt_with_rotation into TOTP signin
criteria: EMBYR_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS resolves via the same three-source mechanism
auth.rs signin uses decrypt_with_rotation instead of a single cipher
Identical current/previous encryption key is rejected at startup
Absent previous key reproduces today's single-key decrypt exactly
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-018 section 3,5,6. Add ConfigError::DuplicateRotationKey{var, base_var}, checked after both values resolve by comparing resolved bytes (not env text). UserAdminState gains encryption_key_previous: Option<[u8;32]>. build_admin_router gains the encryption_key_previous parameter (threaded from cfg); four backward-compat wrapper functions in router.rs pass None. Replace auth.rs's inline Aes256Gcm::new_from_slice/decrypt block with a call to adapters::encryption::decrypt_with_rotation(&state.encryption_key, state.encryption_key_previous.as_ref(), &enc_bytes) -- preserve the existing status-code mapping (Malformed-shaped -> invalid_code() 401 via the existing <12-byte guard already in auth.rs, AuthenticationFailed -> existing 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR). main.rs Step 2 emits tracing::warn! when encryption_key_previous is Some (OQ-3).

steps.name: Dual-token operator_auth_middleware
criteria: EMBYR_ADMIN_KEY_PREVIOUS resolves via the same three-source mechanism
operator_auth_middleware accepts admin_key or admin_key_previous
GET /metrics honors the same dual-token window as other routes
Identical current/previous admin key is rejected at startup
A token matching neither key still returns 401
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-018 section 3,6,7. OperatorState gains admin_key_previous: Option<String>. build_admin_router signature gains admin_key_previous: Option<String>, threaded from cfg; four wrapper fns pass None. operator_auth_middleware accepts a bearer equal to state.admin_key OR state.admin_key_previous (Some). Use the constant-time comparison discipline already established in this codebase for secret comparisons -- grep for constant_time/ct_eq/subtle usage in the auth/Argon2id code paths and match that pattern for the bearer-token comparison rather than a plain == on secret bytes.

dual_auth_middleware Bearer arm accepts either admin key value

steps.name: GcpSecretFetcher raw secret and resolver wiring
criteria: GcpSecretFetcher::get_raw_secret returns the raw secret string
EMBYR_GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN is required only when a GCP name var is set
resolve_secret_source recognises the GCP source for all four secrets
The two GCP subprocess scenarios remain ignored with the OQ-SM-4 reason
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-018 section 3, Alternatives A6, OQ-SM-4. Refactor GcpSecretFetcher::fetch_raw to share the HTTP+base64 portion between the existing parse_dsn path and a new get_raw_secret(resource_name) -> Result<String, GcpSecretError>. In config.rs's resolver, recognise *_GCP_SECRET_NAME as a third source alongside plain and AWS for all four logical secrets; construct GcpSecretFetcher lazily using EMBYR_GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN as the bearer token against the production base URL, erroring with a clear ConfigError if a GCP name var is set but EMBYR_GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN is absent. Do not add a test-only base-URL override -- out of scope per OQ-SM-4/A6; the two GCP subprocess scenarios in sm01/sm01-gcp stay #[ignore]d as DISTILL scaffolded them. Add unit-level coverage for the resolver's GCP branch directly in config.rs's #[cfg(test)] module instead.
